row.name: Discovery Kids Academy of Greater Houston

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: There was no current Health Inspection report available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: A plastic swimming pool on the playground was observed having a hole in it, a play house was observed having a hole in the roof, trash(plastic food wrappings) was observed on the playground accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler: Sippy cups were observed in toddler room not labeled. This was corrected during inspection when caregiver was observed labeling the cups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Fire extinguisher was observed expired during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Cleaning supplies including Clorox, dish soap, and /Comet was observed sitting on the floor of restroom used by children aaccessible to children. This was corrected during inspection when caregiver was observed removing the chemicals and making them inaccesible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Electrical chord was observed hanging from wall accessible to children outside on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: Medication including tylenol and diaper rash ointment was observed stored on bottom shelf accesible to children in the toddler room. This was corrected during the inspection when caregiver was observed removing the medicine from the bottom shelf and storing away from children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: There was no emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted in the toddler room. This was corrected during inspection when director posted a diagram in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: There was no current fire inspection available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children under 2 years of age was observed having screen time. This was corrected during inspection when caregiver was observed turning the screen away from children and allowing the music to play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Scissors: The first aid kit was missing scissors. This was corrected during inspection when director placed a pair of scissors in the first aid guide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Scissors (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One out of four caregiver files reviewed was missing the required 24 clock hour trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Reasonable Accommodations or Modifications: Four children files observed were not updated. The childcare facility did not update the children files to portray the updated required information by 09/01/2023. The files observed did not include updated modifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Reasonable Accommodations or Modifications (26 TAC §746.605(13)(B)(i))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Children were observed having screen time during mealtime. This was corrected during inspection when caregiver was observed turning the screen away from the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress: One crib mattress in the infant room was observed torn and not washable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: There was no current cpr training for director available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care: The first aid kit was missing a first aid guide. This was corrected during inspection when director printed and placed a first aid guide in the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: two out of four staff files reviewed were missing training on Preventing and controlling and responding to emergencies due to food and allergic reaction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: Four children files observed were not updated. The childcare facility did not update the children files to portray the updated required information by 09/01/2023. The files observed did not include updated water activity permissiont.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Caregiver was observed using cell phone while caring for infants during the inspection. This was corrected when the caregiver was observed putting away the cell phone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Four children files observed were not updated. The childcare facility did not update the children files to portray the updated required information by 09/01/2023. The files observed did not include updated special needs statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: There was no current gas inspection available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: There was no food allergy emergency plan available for review for one child with food allergy during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There was no infant feeding instruction sheet obtained or available for review for 6-week old infant during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: There was no current first aid training for director available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: Director file was missing the required 30 clock hour trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who left employment in the 2022 calendar year by January 15.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There was mo documentation of shelter drills, severe weather drills, emergency preparedness plan, or lock-down drills available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: There was no documentation available for review during inspection of dogs vaccination.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §746.3903(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals - Notify Parents in Writing: There was no parent notification available for review during inspection that an animal (dog) was present at the center. This was corrected during inspection when the dog was seen being picked up and remove from the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals - Notify Parents in Writing (26 TAC §746.3901(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A 1-year-old child was observed having screen time during the inspection. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was observed turning off the television and giving the child(ren) another activity to participate in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no written feeding instruction sheets available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There was no documentation of fire extinguishers being inspected monthly available for review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))
